title: Learned continuous prototype routing for bounded state retrieval
question: Can learned continuous prototype routing replace sign-code bucketing while preserving exhaustive cosine state retrieval with a bounded four-state shortlist?
hypothesis: H_prototype: a learned 16-prototype continuous coarse router trained only on the disjoint training codes can assign evaluation states to capacity-four buckets such that one queried prototype yields a sufficiently correct bounded shortlist for cosine reranking.

arms.name: exhaustive_cosine
arms.intervention: cosine-score all M=64 state embeddings with the trained width-16 encoder

arms.name: prototype_selective
arms.intervention: select one learned continuous prototype, retrieve its capacity-four bucket, cosine-rerank those states, then execute the exact downstream candidates

endpoints.name: actual_target_recall
endpoints.role: primary — correct hidden target state selected

endpoints.name: proposal_target_retention
endpoints.role: secondary — true target state is in the selected prototype bucket before reranking

endpoints.name: actual_end_to_end_success
endpoints.role: secondary — downstream output matches hidden environment truth

endpoints.name: state_rerank_macs
endpoints.role: audit — cosine scoring inside selected bucket

decision_rule.condition: prototype_selective actual target recall >= exhaustive_cosine actual target recall - 0.05 AND prototype_selective actual end-to-end success >= exhaustive_cosine actual end-to-end success - 0.05 AND shortlist size <= 4
decision_rule.licenses: bounded support for learned continuous prototype routing as a selective state-retrieval boundary on this workload
decision_rule.does_not_license: general learned ANN guarantees, hardware speedup, or broad C5

decision_rule.condition: either actual target recall or actual end-to-end success is more than 0.05 below the exhaustive-cosine reference, or shortlist exceeds 4
decision_rule.licenses: the registered prototype selective boundary does not preserve the exhaustive learned-cosine capability sufficiently
decision_rule.does_not_license: that learned prototype routing is impossible

held_constant: cosine reranking within the selected bucket
same learned weights used by exhaustive and selective arms
prototype construction uses only training-code embeddings; evaluation states are only assigned to buckets at runtime build
no evaluation address or gold target enters prototype learning
